title: API Key Expiration Policies and Notifications
summary: Organization and Workspace administrators can now enforce maximum expiration dates for API keys, eliminating the risk of immortal keys and improving overall security posture. Additionally, automatic email notifications alert users before their keys expire, preventing unexpected service disruptions.
whatsNew: Organization and Workspace administrators can now enforce maximum expiration dates for API keys, eliminating the risk of immortal keys and improving overall security posture. Additionally, automatic email notifications alert users before their keys expire, preventing unexpected service disruptions.
keyCapabilities: Configurable expiration limits: Admins can set maximum validity periods for API keys at the Organization or Workspace level.
Elimination of immortal keys: Removes the ability to create API keys without an expiration date.
Expiration email notifications: Automatically alerts users as their API keys approach expiration to prevent service disruptions.
Policy enforcement: Automatically enforces expiration policies upon the creation and rotation of API keys.

getStarted.label: Administrators can configure API key expiration policies within their Organization or Workspace settings. Refer to the documentation for guidance on setting up expiration limits and managing notifications.
